item1.heading: Who does Ambit work with?
item1.body: Ambit works with startups, owner-managed businesses, professional firms, and international companies operating in or entering the US market.

item2.heading: Do you support non-US residents and foreign-owned companies?
item2.body: Yes. We support non-resident founders, foreign-owned US entities, and international groups with US tax, accounting, compliance, and structuring requirements.

item3.heading: Do you only provide tax filing services?
item3.body: No. We provide advisory, accounting, payroll, compliance, structuring, and ongoing finance support through monthly retainers and outsourcing models.

item4.heading: How does your engagement process work?
item4.body: We begin with a free consultation, followed by a diagnostic review, scope definition, onboarding, and assignment of a dedicated engagement team with senior oversight.

item5.heading: How do you ensure data security and confidentiality?
item5.body: We use secure client portals, encrypted systems, role-based access controls, and governance-led internal reviews to protect client data.

item6.heading: Can Ambit act as our extended finance team?
item6.body: Yes. Through our monthly retainer and remote staffing models, Ambit works as an extension of your internal finance and accounting function.

item7.heading: How to start a Conversation?
item7.body: Whether you are forming a US entity, managing ongoing compliance, or seeking long-term advisory support, Ambit is here to help. Schedule a consultation to discuss your business needs and next steps.
